**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king is exposed, prioritize forcing checks over quiet moves. Use your rooks to drive the king into corners where it can't escape, then coordinate both pieces for mate. Always look for checks that activate your pieces while pushing the enemy king toward danger.
